meta_description: PJS Decorators Southampton. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes. Local family business established since 2008.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering across Southampton. Free quotes, no obligation.
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality finishes, and leave your home spotless on completion.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with durable exterior paint systems. Weather-resistant finishes keep your property looking fresh for years.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging for feature walls and complete rooms. We source quality papers and ensure flawless installation with precision pattern matching.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting
services.desc: Expert painting and restoration of doors, skirting boards, and wooden trim. We use hard-wearing finishes that look elegant and stand up to daily wear.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Unsure which colours suit your space? We offer honest design advice and can show you samples in your home's lighting before you commit.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Retail units, offices, and business premises refreshed on schedule. We work around your opening hours and minimise disruption to your operations.

about_pullquote: We paint homes like we'd paint our own, with care and respect for every detail.
about_para_1: PJS Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Southampton for over two decades. Started as a family operation, we've grown through word-of-mouth recommendation and a reputation for honest pricing and reliable work. Every job, big or small, gets the same level of preparation and craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we turn up on time, explain the work clearly, and deliver exactly what we promise. We're not a big corporate chain—we're local, we care about our reputation, and we've built lasting relationships with families and businesses across the area.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge completely redecorated—new wallpaper, fresh paint, the lot. The lads were tidy, quick, and really friendly. Finished a day early too. Would definitely book them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed doing badly. Got a few quotes but PJS gave the best price and actually stuck to it. Looks brilliant now. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: Very professional. Came out for a free quote, explained everything clearly, and did exactly what they said. No mess, fair pricing. Will use them for the spare bedroom next.
reviews.author: David H.
